questions.q: What is a Teams or Slack incoming webhook?
options: A unique URL that posts a message into a specific channel when a JSON payload is POSTed to it
A SQL Server Agent alert type built into the database engine
A dedicated SMTP relay server for sending email
A GUI dashboard for viewing chat history
questions.explain: Both platforms expose incoming webhooks as a URL you POST a JSON payload to, which then appears as a message in the target channel.

questions.q: What PowerShell cmdlet does this lesson use to post to a Teams/Slack webhook?
options: Invoke-RestMethod, the same standard cmdlet used to call any REST API
Send-MailMessage, PowerShell's built-in email cmdlet
New-DbaAgentJob, a dbatools-specific cmdlet
Invoke-Command, PowerShell's remoting cmdlet
questions.explain: A chat webhook is just a REST API with one endpoint, so the standard Invoke-RestMethod is the right tool.

questions.q: What does this lesson say about the current status of `Send-MailMessage`?
options: Microsoft has marked it obsolete because it lacks support for current secure authentication methods most mail providers now require
It was never a real PowerShell cmdlet
It is the actively recommended, fully modern way to send email from PowerShell
It has been completely removed from every version of PowerShell
questions.explain: The lesson is explicit and honest that Send-MailMessage is obsolete, without claiming it has been fully removed.

questions.q: What does the lesson suggest as realistic modern replacements for `Send-MailMessage`?
options: Calling a transactional email API directly, or using a dedicated .NET mail library such as MailKit for full SMTP control
There is no replacement; email alerting from PowerShell is no longer possible
Only Send-MailMessage itself, since it's still fully supported
Switching entirely to SQL Server Agent database mail
questions.explain: The lesson names both a REST-API-based approach and a dedicated library as honest, realistic alternatives.

questions.q: Why does the lesson say a webhook is usually a more reliable default for DBA alerting than email?
options: It doesn't depend on SMTP relay configuration or mailbox credentials, and it lands in a channel the whole on-call team already watches
Email cannot technically be sent from any script under any circumstances
Webhooks require no internet connection at all
Chat platforms guarantee alerts are read within one minute by law
questions.explain: The lesson's stated reasoning is about reliability of delivery and visibility to the team, not a hard technical limitation of email.
